section: §81 — P0 dispatch surfaced 3 systemic apr pretrain output metadata gaps

P0_dispatch_attempts.error: Validation failed: APR missing embedded tokenizer
P0_dispatch_attempts.underlying_defect: apr pretrain output does not embed the source tokenizer into the .apr file
P0_dispatch_attempts.fix_scope: ~50 LOC in pretrain.rs to read tokenizer.json from --tokenizer dir and embed via AprWriter::add_tokenizer + 1 test

P0_dispatch_attempts.error: Validation failed: Failed to create quantized model from APR: Invalid configuration: C-03: APR model missing 'hidden_size' metadata
P0_dispatch_attempts.underlying_defect: apr pretrain output does not write hidden_size (and likely other arch keys: num_attention_heads, num_kv_heads, intermediate_size, num_hidden_layers) to .apr metadata
P0_dispatch_attempts.fix_scope: ~30 LOC in pretrain.rs to extract config keys from --init APR or --vocab-size + build_transformer_config + 1 test

P0_dispatch_attempts.command_a_outcome: PASS — 2.35 GiB GGUF / 291 tensors / Export successful
P0_dispatch_attempts.command_b_outcome: FAIL — error loading model architecture: unknown model architecture: 'LlamaForCausalLM'
P0_dispatch_attempts.underlying_defect: apr export --format gguf writes architecture="LlamaForCausalLM" (HuggingFace transformers convention) but llama.cpp/GGUF convention is lowercase architecture="llama"
P0_dispatch_attempts.fix_scope: ~10 LOC in export.rs to map HF arch names to GGUF arch names + 1 test (case mapping table for llama, qwen2, mistral, phi3, gpt2, ...)

ship_pct_impact.actual: 0pp — all three blocked on output-side packaging defects
ship_pct_impact.revised_path: The P0 trio is REQUIRED but requires 3 packaging fixes first (estimated ~90 LOC + 3 tests over 1-2 days). After those land, the P0 dispatches should pass as originally predicted.

root_cause_categorization.class: Class 3 — Infrastructure / packaging defect, NOT data starvation or optimization defect
root_cause_categorization.framing: Per §79 methodology lesson #26, this is the same class as the §22 silent-fallback and §22 early-stop bugs — infrastructure that produces correct-looking output but lacks downstream-tool-required metadata
root_cause_categorization.why_audit_missed_this: The external audit (docs/specifications/two-model-spec-audit.md) focused on convergence root causes. Packaging defects only surface when you try to OPERATE on a converged checkpoint. §78 + P0 dispatch is the first time this lifecycle stage has been reached.
root_cause_categorization.methodology_lesson: Class 3 (infrastructure) defects come in waves — first wave masks data signal (§22), second wave masks packaging readiness (§81). Each wave needs its own surfacing dispatch.

revised_priority.after_81: P0-D (embed tokenizer) → P0-E (write hidden_size + arch keys) → P0-F (GGUF arch case mapping) → P0-A → P0-B → P0-C
revised_priority.estimated_compute_to_81pp_revised: ~6 hours of code work + the original <10 min P0 dispatch compute
